strings.en: Problem... detected.
...Space...
It must be... silent...
...Hating one another...
Not wanted.
Not wanted... this world.
Not wanted... this world... correction...
Completion...
...A new... life...
...Failure.
...As expected... humans are...
...Seriously. I can't take this anymore.
Here we go again. Shinobu's off on another rant.
Just let him be. You only notice because you keep answering him.
What was that!? Why you, Sara!
Shinobu, can't you be quiet for once?
Like I can stay quiet in a situation like this!
We went through hell crushing that Muge bastard, and when we got back,
there's more trouble with the Titans and whatnot.
And once that got sorted, why do we have to get shipped off
to the boonies like this? ...Isn't it fine, though?
If it's Japan, home's close by.
Masato, that's enough joking around.
...But I get where Shinobu's coming from. It's a polite way of demoting us.
It's because the brass fears great power running out of control.
It's a fact that the Titans, under the pretext of hunting Zeon remnants,
tried to rule Earth and space by force.
The Gryps Conflict, huh. ...In the end, the ones who settled it
were the Argama unit led by Captain Bright.
But afterward, the Argama unit was disbanded for being too powerful.
Now they've been given only a new battleship and a meager force,
and made an independent strike unit, apparently.
So, same treatment as us.
I really don't like how the Federation bigwigs do things.
...You said it.
When that Dr. Hell guy started spouting about world conquest
and attacked, they didn't do a damn thing either.
Speaking of Dr. Hell, the ones that beat his Mechanical Beast army,
Mazinger Z and Great Mazinger, got sent to a museum, I hear.
Geez, Dancougar's gathering dust on deck, and they get the good life.
Idiot.
Mazinger's too strong for a private lab to keep, so someone pulled strings.
Lose the "idiot"! I know that already!
It's pretty noisy here. Did something happen?
Another fight?
Oh, hey. Come to think of it, you two got assigned here too, right?
We've got a loudmouth, but don't mind him.
Christina, you just went from test pilot to regular pilot, right?
Getting used to it?
Just Chris is fine, Yuki.
Then call me Sara too. Anyway...
if you're here, the mobile suits have been delivered, right?
The Gundam NT-1 Alex and Bernie's Zaku II Kai... all delivered.
Tuning's done too, so we can launch anytime. If we ever get to, that is.
A Zaku!? Why a Zeon mobile suit, huh, Bernie?
Well, I'm not too good with Federation machines...
I saw both your records, and Bernie's history was listed as unknown.
...How come?
Seems there's some kind of story there... Well, I don't mind.
Heh, that four-eyed geezer just loves shady types.
Scientists are always like that...
...The pilots assigned here today have stories of their own, Fujiwara.
Commander Hazuki, what do you mean?
Yes. A rookie fresh out of test piloting, a former Argama pilot,
and one from the Kojima Battalion on the Southeast Asian front. Three.
The Kojima... Battalion?
The 08th MS Team... Perhaps that rings a bell.
Oh! The unit with Ground Gundams made from First Gundam spare parts,
low-spec machines that still racked up results... in the Far East Army?
I see you know of them.
In the last war, he was suspected of colluding with the enemy,
and he was about to be discharged when I took him in.
Geez, Hazuki, you sure love this kind of thing.
His skills are genuine.
Besides, I simply can't see him as someone so underhanded.
In case another enemy like the Muge Empire appears,
we ought to have our forces in order. And besides...
Besides?
Heh. Simply by commanding the Cyber Beast Force,
I've been treated as a maverick in the military since the last war.
Yeah, yeah, thanks a lot.
...Heh.
Gimme a break.
Jaburo...? Is this information reliable?
Sir. Federation command seems intact, but I believe it's true.
Understood. Dismissed.
...Sir.
I see... So that's why the Zeon homeland,
only now, has ordered attacks on regional bases.
...But could such a thing really happen...?
Without anyone seeing it at all? Impossible...
Colonel Packard.
Ah... Lord Ginias,
you needn't come all this way. You had only to summon me...
I've heard about Jaburo as well.
Yes, it's truly baffling.
...There's no sign that a major battle took place. And yet...
The process doesn't interest me... Only the facts matter.
Sir...
In that case... there's one more place we must strike.
Sir? And where is that...
Japan.
Japan... The Federation's Far East Branch?
Development of the prototype of that thing is going well.
For now... it can fly. I want you to take that one along... as a test.
...! You mustn't. The heart's wounds from the last war haven't healed.
A little more rest is needed...
It doesn't matter. In any case... ngh, cough!
Lord Ginias, the air here is bad. It will harm your health.
Leave this to me.
A mere base in a small island nation doesn't warrant the new model.
...Very well... I leave it to you. I'll return to my room...
Yes, leave it to me.
(...Brother and sister, of the same blood, and yet... It's simply too cruel...)
Colonel Packard! We're ready to launch!
Still... it can't be helped for now... Moving out!
(Still, it bothers me... Jaburo?
The fortress even Char Aznable had to retreat from... fell in a night?)
So this is the Cyber Beast Force base...
I heard this was a demotion, but it's more respectable than I expected.
(That accident may have been the direct cause... but it doesn't add up.
It's that one they should keep within reach, not me...
We're nothing but former test pilots for prototypes...
What is the top brass thinking?)
This is the place. Oh, excuse me.
Hm... You're... Fa Yuiry? And... Lieutenant Shiro Amada?
I'll be joining you as of today. Good to meet you. And you are?
Kyosuke Nanbu. Please, call me Kyosuke.
I was assigned here today too... as pilot of the prototype Alteisen.
Likewise, nice to meet you. I fly... a support unit.
The transformable Methuss... Wasn't that an Argama mobile suit?
Weren't you on the Argama's crew too, Yuiry?
...Yes. He was hurt in the fighting against the Titans...
and I came to Earth with my childhood friend while he recovered...
but just as he started to get better, he was sent off to a Jaburo facility...
...Kamille Bidan... I hear he was an outstanding pilot...
...Yes. And then I was transferred to the Far East Branch in Japan...
Kamille... I've heard he was a Newtype.
And Captain Amuro Ray was also pulled from the Argama,
and demoted to some backwater on Earth under virtual house arrest...
Sending away every capable person... What are they planning...?
Kamille...
Let's just see Commander Hazuki. Something is off with the Federation.
But just talking about it here won't change anything.
Sir.
I'm sorry. You're very positive, Lieutenant Amada.
It's the only thing I've got going for me.
A~ki~to~!
Wh-What?
Starting today, you're a member of the Nadesico too!
Yeah, but I never thought Yurika would be the captain...
She may not look it, but the Captain went undefeated in strategy
simulation exercises at Federation University. Quite the talent.
Wow, really?
Ahem!
(Yeah, right...)
So this is the Nadesico!
Who are you?
The name's Gai! Gai Daigoji!
Huh? It says Jiro Yamada here...
That's just a temporary name. Gai Daigoji is the name of my soul.
My true name!
...Idiot.
Is this battleship really going to be okay...?
I'm worried about our future...
No need to worry. Apart from Tenkawa, our last-minute cook,
everyone is elite talent handpicked for the Scaparelli Project.
The Scaparelli... Project?
The Scaparelli Project...
Put simply, it's our plan at Nergal to retake Mars.
Retake Mars...
Even though many people had colonized Mars,
after the Meganoid Rebellion, the Federation only defended Earth.
The people of Mars are still living hard lives, harassed by mysterious
unmanned weapons... the Jovian Lizards.
...The only town left on Mars...
is the Mars Frontier Base, built on an old Meganoid base, right?
Meganoids, huh. Tch, if I'd been a pilot back then,
I'd have blown 'em away along with those lizard bastards!
(Mars... Utopia Colony...)
Akito...? Thinking about something? Oh, I know! You were thinking of me!
(If only I'd been stronger back then...)
Never mind, Akito. I'm nothing without you... I mean, the Nadesico is!
Captain, we're not getting anywhere.
Ahem. ...We were chosen to save those people of Mars.
And so our destination is, of course, Mars.
(...!? I can go back to Mars!?)
All right, let's hurry to Mars and become heroes!
But is it really okay to build a battleship like this on our own?
No need to worry about that. It should all be settled with the Federation.
Huh? But isn't Jaburo out of contact right now?
Is it really okay to fly off in a situation like that?
...! I-It's fine!
It's precisely because of the situation that we must take a stand!
(I can hardly say we don't want to get dragged into the mess...)
And so, everyone, let's do our best and head for Mars!
...And that's the situation, Commander Hazuki.
Good heavens... But with your current forces...
won't it be difficult to hold back the Vega Star Federation?
I know. But... we have to do it.
What of the Jovian Lizards seen on Mars since the Meganoid Rebellion?
They haven't made any notable moves lately.
I see... Mysterious unmanned weapons of unknown origin...
Whose machines could they be...?
There are rumors they might be Meganoid survivors...
Mars... Just after it recovered from the Meganoid Rebellion...
The only place still functioning there now is...?
The Mars Frontier Base...
It's ironic that the town was built on the ruins of a Meganoid base.
Who's the Commander talking to...? Is that Captain Bright of the Argama?
Londo Bell, to be exact. Seems space is getting noisy again...
Zeon, again?
Doesn't seem like it. Something about Vega...
Vega? Is something like the Muge Empire invading again?
They were saying something about Jovian whatevers too.
Tch, if we could take out Dancougar, it wouldn't matter what showed up.
Now, now. Let's just hear what they have to say.
What about reinforcements from Konpeito or Satsuki Midori Colony?
Just like Jaburo... we can't get through to them.
Strange... I've heard nothing of that... Then, in terms of strength...
Frankly, we're in a tough spot.
Grendizer is somehow keeping us afloat, but...
we simply don't have enough pilots.
We were told they'd send us a new model, but...
all we got was a prototype passed over for production due to cost,
and a single pilot for it.
Same as us. One prototype and its pilot, nothing more...
And that machine is a Gespenst Type 3.
Type 3... I've rarely heard of a Mk-III.
Strictly, it's from the ATX Project, the Personal Trooper upgrade plan.
It was developed using the preserved Unit 3 as its base.
But only one prototype exists. It has power, but it's far too specialized.
Ours is a custom Gespenst Mk-II, the mass-production prototype.
Even with the military cutbacks...
The ATX Project...
Yet to send a canceled machine to the front lines...
What is the top brass thinking...?
I understand. ...Even so,
I intend to hold the defense line against Earth descent at all costs...
I have a proposal.
Please add Dancougar... the Cyber Beast Force to Londo Bell.
We have few decent supplies, and its tuning isn't complete, but...
its combat ability should be more than enough.
Dancougar...!? I'd be grateful, but it's outside my jurisdiction.
With Jaburo out of contact...
I can't just move forces around on my own...
Captain, forgive me for cutting in, but Commander Hazuki may have a point.
Right now, the only one of us that can down a saucer beast in one blow
is Grendizer.
Dancougar's combat ability was proven in the last war.
...Hmm, but...
...What if they disobeyed orders and went to Londo Bell on their own?
Whoa, Hazuki, so you're telling us to disobey orders?
...Fujiwara.
Hell yeah, let's do it!
If I stay on ground duty any longer, I'm gonna go nuts from boredom!
Besides, it's not the first time we've disobeyed orders. Right, Shinobu?
What's that supposed to mean, Sara? Like I'm always...
And there you have it, Captain Bright.
I expect they'll cause you all sorts of trouble... Is that all right?
...Understood. We'd be glad to have them.
Oh, that's right, Commander Hazuki.
Is there something else?
...Commander, there's one thing I should tell you.
The pilots assigned to the Gandor Team and to Londo Bell...
both are likely... survivors of that accident.
...Not that it means anything in particular...
In fact, the girl who came to us is a skilled pilot.
...Though her personality seems a bit problematic.
But... why, amid these cutbacks, were they assigned now of all times...
...I understand.
...Though as long as we can't reach Jaburo, there's no way to confirm it...
(That accident... only two survivors:
Kyosuke Nanbu and Excellen Browning...)
Space, huh... Heh, it's been a while.
Just Dancougar? What about us...?
They're a small force, but I'm worried about the Zeon ground forces too.
We can't commit all our strength.
Aw, if only Mazinger Z and the others were still active...
Knock it off. Saying that won't get us anywhere.
Huh...? Then why...
Lieutenant Amada? What's wrong?
Well, before coming here, I visited the Robot Science Museum.
Why'd you go there?
Just personal interest. I'd been on the Asian front the whole time.
I wanted to see the famous super robots for myself. And then...
Both of them were operational... is that it?
No, they said Mazinger Z had been sent back
to the Photon Power Laboratory for maintenance.
I wondered why they couldn't just do it on-site.
...So Professor Yumi is concerned too, then.
(...Perhaps the time has come to decide.)
Commander...?
We'll awaken... the Dragon...!
The Dragon?
Heh, it's been a while since Gandor or Dancougar got a turn!
